title: 2  Understanding Data Types in Clojure
text:
2.1 Creating Arrays from Clojure Lists and Vectors
Original python code:
This notation [Ljava.lang.Object; with the open bracket at the beginning, but no closing bracket is the JVM’s way of saying, “An array of the following type.” What follows the [ indicates the types in the array. In this case, the Ljava.lang.Object; means this is just a an array of objects.
table source
Anytime we don’t explicitly give it a datatype, it will be considered an array of objects. It is more useful to provide a type:

Unlike Numpy, dtype won’t automatically infer the data type. It is better to be explicit.

We will use tech.v3.tensor as dtt to create multidimensional arrays. Here we indicate the data type in an options map at the end of the arguments list.

3.1 Simple Linear Regression
Let us create some random data going approximately along a line.
Original python code:
We use efficient array-like processing through dtype-next, but of course we could also use plain map calls for the arithmetic, and it would be just fine for this size of data.
Let us find an optimal line predicting y by x (“linear regression”).
Original python code:
Note: the layers function we are using here is still experimental.

title: 3  In Depth: Linear Regression - DRAFT
text:
rng = np.random.RandomState(1)
x = 10 * rng.rand(50)
y = 2 * x - 5 + rng.randn(50)
plt.scatter(x, y);

(def rng
  (random/rng 1))



(def x
  (-> (dtype/make-reader :float32 50 (random/drandom rng))
      (fun/* 10)
      dtype/clone))


(def y
  (-> x
      (fun/* 2)
      (fun/- 5)
      (fun/+ (dtype/make-reader :float32 50 (random/grandom rng)))
      dtype/clone))


(def scatter
  (-> {:x x :y y}
      tc/dataset
      (hanami/plot ht/point-chart {})))


scatter




from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression(fit_intercept=True)

model.fit(x[:, np.newaxis], y)

xfit = np.linspace(0, 10, 1000)
yfit = model.predict(xfit[:, np.newaxis])

plt.scatter(x, y)
plt.plot(xfit, yfit);

(def model
  (fun/linear-regressor x y))



(let [xfit (range 0 10 1/100)
      yfit (map model xfit)]
  (hanami/layers nil
                 {}
                 [scatter
                  (-> {:x xfit
                       :y yfit}
                      tc/dataset
                      (hanami/plot ht/line-chart {:MCOLOR "brown"}))]))
